definitions.explanation: Spending more money than usual, often as a special treat or gesture of generosity. The most common modern usage.

definitions.gloss: exerting oneself; rousing oneself to action
definitions.explanation: Summoning up energy, courage, or determination to tackle something. Composed of 奮 (rouse/stir up) + 発 (emit/express).

notes:
USAGE:
{奮発|ふんぱつ} is most commonly used as a suru-verb ({奮発|ふんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). In modern usage, sense 1 (splurging) is far more common than sense 2 (exerting oneself). The spending sense typically implies a happy, voluntary decision to spend more than usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奮発|ふんぱつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (splurge and buy)
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{奮発|ふんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (splurge a little)
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}って→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧{奮発|ふんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (decide to splurge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to be extravagant" and focuses on luxury itself, while {奮発|ふんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ emphasizes the decision to spend more than usual as a special occasion.
